title: Squeeze and relax for a calm body
examples: How do I relax my body?

steps.label: Curl toes
steps.note: Curl your toes. Hold. Let go.

steps.label: Floppy body
steps.note: Let your whole body go soft.
steps.ask: When can I do squeeze and relax?

explain.say: When you feel worried or cross, your muscles can get tight. Squeeze and relax helps them go soft. Look at the board. You squeeze one part of your body. Then you let it go.

explain.say: Step 1 is squeeze fists. Squeeze your hands tight. Count 1, 2, 3. Now let go. Your hands feel soft now. That soft feeling is called relaxed.

explain.say: Step 2 is shoulders up. Lift your shoulders up to your ears. Hold them there. Now drop them down. Next, scrunch your face tight. Then let it go soft. Can you feel the difference?

explain.say: Step 4 is curl toes. Curl your toes tight inside your shoes. Hold. Now let go. Squeezing first helps you notice how relaxed feels. Which part feels the most relaxed?

explain.say: The last step is floppy body. Let your whole body go soft and heavy. Now your whole body is relaxed. Tonight, try squeeze and relax in bed. Start with your toes and finish with your face.

faq.a: Squeezing first makes the letting go feel bigger. Your muscles learn the difference between tight and soft.

faq.q: When can I do squeeze and relax?
faq.a: When you feel worried, cross, or tight. It is great at bedtime too. You can do the fists one quietly at your desk.
About three seconds. Squeeze firmly, but never so hard that it hurts.

faq.q: Can I do it sitting down?
faq.a: Yes. Fists, shoulders, face and toes all work in a chair.
asks: Can I do it at my desk?

faq.q: What if it does not help?
faq.a: Try belly breaths, a movement break, or telling a grown-up you trust. Different tools help at different times.

facts: Tensing and then relaxing muscles one group at a time is a well-known relaxation method.
When people feel worried, their muscles often tighten without them noticing.

quiz.say: Kofi squeezes his fists tight. He counts to 3. What does he do next?
quiz.why: After the squeeze, you let go. Your muscles feel soft and relaxed.

wrong.0: Squeezing too hard can hurt, so let go after 3.
wrong.2: Running wakes your body up, and this tool helps it go soft.

quiz.say: Mei feels worried. Her shoulders are up by her ears. What can help?
quiz.show: 😟 Mei's shoulders are up by her ears. What helps?
quiz.why: Lifting and then dropping her shoulders helps the muscles relax. The tight feeling can ease.

wrong.1: Keeping her shoulders up keeps the muscles tight.
wrong.2: Shaking her head fast can make her feel dizzy.
